UAE e-invoicing for businesses under AED 50 million, month by month.

For in-scope businesses with revenue under AED 50 million, Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025 sets ASP appointment by 31 March 2027 and implementation by 1 July 2027 (mof.gov.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026).

Dec: gap assessment
Jan: fix data and ERP output
Feb: compare and shortlist; Mar: appoint early, plan testing
